findings.title: Test automatic organization immediately after a trip
findings.analysis_unit_statement: People want to share trip photos, but filtering duplicates and regrouping images takes time.
findings.decision_summary: The smallest useful test is automatic filtering and grouping after a trip, not a complete photo-management product.
findings.audience: Phone users who return from a trip with hundreds of photos and want to share without reviewing every image
findings.evidence_boundary: This synthetic evidence only demonstrates how to design a small demand test; it cannot establish market size, retention, or willingness to pay.

recommended_actions.action: Test a clickable prototype that imports one trip album, removes obvious duplicates, and groups photos by location
recommended_actions.condition: Test only the first organization task after a trip, not long-term library management
recommended_actions.validation_metric: At least 3 of 5 participants import real photos and complete a share-ready album
recommended_actions.stop_condition: Most participants prefer their existing photo app or will not grant photo access
recommended_actions.human_boundary: Users must confirm access, deletion, and external sharing of real photos

report_sections.decision_answer: Test one-time automatic trip-photo organization before building a complete photo-management product.
report_sections.user_tasks: Select the photos worth keeping and sharing from a large trip album.
report_sections.workarounds_and_failures: People use the system photo app, manually favorite images, or leave the album untouched; duplicate volume and selection effort are the main problems.
report_sections.mvp_scope: Import one trip album, identify obvious duplicates, group by time and location, and produce an album for confirmation.
report_sections.validation_metrics: Measure real-photo import, completion, active sharing, and the proportion of suggested photos retained.
report_sections.stop_conditions: Stop expanding if users reject photo access, existing tools are sufficient, or automatic grouping does not reduce organization time.
report_sections.evidence_boundary: This demonstrates the report structure and decision method; it does not show that demand exists on X.
